posts.trend: How Indians can build a diabetes-friendly lifestyle without extreme diets
posts.context: Urban Indians are hitting their thirties and realizing their bodies are starting to break down from a decade of poor lifestyle choices.
posts.angle: The body at 30 doesn't care about your appraisal cycle; it's running its own financial year.
slides: Your body is running a different financial year than your career.

Your salary increased by 8% this year.

Your fasting blood sugar increased by 15%.

The promotion is still pending.

The prescription is already active.
posts.caption: The body keeps the score, and it’s winning. 📉
posts.rank_verdict: The comparison between salary and blood sugar is a tired corporate cliché that lacks genuine surprise.
